options: To compress something so it takes less space
To hide something from unauthorised readers
To make something clear and understandable
To copy something to a second location
To break something into smaller pieces
questions.explanation: Disambiguation means to make something clear and understandable, the opposite of ambiguous.

questions.stem: What does the word Ambiguous describe?
options: Data that has been duplicated across systems
Data that is missing from a dataset
Data that is stored in an outdated format
Data that is too large to process quickly
Something unclear, especially when the same words are used for multiple purposes
questions.explanation: Ambiguous means something which is unclear, especially when the same words are used for multiple purposes.

questions.stem: What is described as the biggest use case for Data Disambiguation?
options: Handling sarcasm
Detecting duplicate customer records
Compressing audio and video files
Balancing data across cluster nodes
Translating documents between languages
questions.explanation: Data Disambiguation's biggest use case is handling sarcasm, where dual-meaning words are heavily used.

questions.stem: Why is sarcasm a particular challenge for Data Disambiguation?
options: Because sarcasm only appears in audio, never in text
Because dual-meaning words are heavily used in sarcasm
Because sarcasm is always written in capital letters
Because sarcasm is rare on social media
Because sarcasm cannot be stored as unstructured data
questions.explanation: In sarcasm, words with dual meanings are heavily used, so the right meaning has to be dug out of confusing statements.

questions.stem: The phrase What's up? is used as an example in Data Disambiguation. What does it illustrate?
options: That greetings should be removed from datasets
That short phrases are easier to classify than long ones
That slang cannot be processed by machines
That the same phrase can be a friendly greeting or an expression of anger at a stranger
That questions are always ambiguous
questions.explanation: What's up? can be a greeting to a friend or a way of showing anger to an unknown person in a restricted area, showing how one phrase carries two meanings.

questions.stem: Which of these is one of the jobs of the Data Disambiguation process?
options: Distribute data evenly across cluster nodes
Fill missing values with the mean
Archive data older than a set retention period
Encrypt dual-meaning words before storage
Translate or replace dual-meaning words with single-meaning words so the end user is not confused
questions.explanation: One job of Data Disambiguation is to translate or replace dual-meaning words with single-meaning words so the end user is not confused before taking a decision.

questions.stem: Which of these is NOT a job of the Data Disambiguation process?
options: Dig out the right meaning from confusing statements
Understand the right concept of a statement
Compress audio and video files to save storage
Remove anything that can corrupt the behaviour of a pattern
Replace dual-meaning words with single-meaning words
questions.explanation: Compressing files is not part of disambiguation; its jobs are to find the right meaning, understand the concept, remove what corrupts a pattern, and replace dual-meaning words.

questions.stem: In which data activity can Data Disambiguation be used?
options: Data Wrangling
Data Mirroring
Data Compression
Load Balancing
Data Archiving
questions.explanation: Data Disambiguation can be used in Data Wrangling, and it can also assist in producing Data Quality rules and generating Metadata.

questions.stem: Besides Data Wrangling, what can Data Disambiguation assist in producing?
options: Backup schedules
Network topologies
Encryption keys
Data Quality rules and Metadata for better data understanding
Cluster node assignments
questions.explanation: Data Disambiguation can assist in producing Data Quality rules and in generating Metadata for better data understanding.

questions.stem: In the current era, what has become one of the major sources for customer profiling?
options: Printed surveys
Social media
Telephone directories
Paper invoices
Internal HR systems
questions.explanation: Social media has become one of the major sources for customer profiling, with audio and video as further sources of semi- and unstructured data.
